newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 24.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Farmers in the northern Jaffna peninsula get seed paddy for the coming cultivation season, says minister Nimal Siripala de Silva, chairman of the rehabilitation task force. Jaffna, the former stronghold of the LTTE (Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam), was retaken by Sri Lanka troops earlier this year.
Police seize 100 million rupees worth of hashish from a trawler off Chilaw, north of Colombo.

A total of 37,000 public sector employees express willingness to retire under old regulations, which allowed them to retire with full pension after 10 years service. Under new regulations which came into force today, a public servant may retire after 20 years of service, but can draw pension only after reaching the age of 55. The new regulations are part of the government's public sector reform programme.
